entities.summary: Kyzir Rasim White is an American professional football linebacker. He played college football for the Lackawanna Falcons and West Virginia Mountaineers and was selected by the Los Angeles Chargers in the fourth round of the 2018 NFL draft. He has also played for the Arizona Cardinals, Philadelphia Eagles, and Tennessee Titans.
